BONA FIDE SUPPORT

How can we help?

For app support, a question correction or help with your subscription, email hello@emdrflow.app.

Report a question

Include the question text or a screenshot and explain what seems wrong. A link to the relevant official source helps us review it.

Subscription help

If you already subscribed, open Bona Fide Settings and choose Restore Purchases. To manage or cancel your plan, open your device's Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.

Study guarantee

For registration or a claim under the annual-plan study guarantee, email us. See the Terms of Use for eligibility and deadlines.

Privacy

Read our Privacy Policy or contact us with a privacy request. Please do not include payment-card details in your email.
